title: RNeasy Mini Kit Protocol for RNA Isolation from Cells
author: Maysa Silva
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ssbeean

steps.title: Prepare Cell Lysate
steps.instruction: Add RLT buffer to the cells based on cell count and homogenize.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μl of RLT buffer if using less than 5 x 10^6 cells; otherwise, use 700 μl.
Homogenize samples using a vortex or QIAshredder.
If necessary, use an insulin syringe to break the cells.

steps.title: Add Ethanol to Lysate
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume of 70% ethanol to the lysate and homogenize with the pipette.

steps.title: Load Sample onto Column
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to an RNeasy Mini spin column and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 μl of the sample, including any precipitate, to an RNeasy Mini spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Wash Column with RW1
steps.instruction: Wash the column using RW1 buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μl of RW1 buffer to the column.

steps.title: First RPE Wash
steps.instruction: Perform the first wash with RPE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl of RPE buffer to the column.

steps.title: Second RPE Wash
steps.instruction: Perform the second wash with RPE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl of RPE buffer to the column.

steps.title: Dry the Membrane
steps.instruction: Optional: Dry the membrane by centrifuging the column in a new 2 mL collection tube at full speed for one minute.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA using RNase-free water.

substeps.instruction: Place the column in a new 1.5 mL collector tube.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 8000 g to elute the RNA.

steps.title: Optional Second Elution
steps.instruction: If more than 30 μg of RNA is expected, repeat the elution process.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the elution step using 30 to 50 μl of RNase-free water.
Reuse the pickup tube from the first elution.
